summary: Describes active tail extensions to Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD) for multipoint networks. These let the receiving ends of a multipoint path take a more active part, such as telling the sender about their state. It builds on the multipoint BFD work and is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: In a group check where one person calls out, this lets listeners answer back too, so the caller knows who can hear.
